faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes GLA45 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: The GLA45 AMG uses the M139 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder engine. It was fitted across both generations — X156 (2013–2020) and H247 (2020–present).

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes GLA45 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,600. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my GLA45 AMG?
faqLeft.a: Every GLA45 AMG uses the M139 engine. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact generation and specification.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M139 GLA45 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain, bearings, gaskets, and cooling components as standard on every M139 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you supply used GLA45 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my GLA45 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a GLA45 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most GLA45 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

faqRight.q: Is the GLA45 AMG engine hand-built?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M139 is assembled under AMG's "One Man, One Engine" philosophy, with each engine built by a single technician.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
